items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $R$ with a partial order and ordered ring structure, and for elements $a, b \in R$ satisfying $0 \leq a$, $0 \leq b^2$, $0 \leq (a + b)^2$, and $0 \leq 2a + b$, it holds that for all natural numbers $n$, $a^n + n a^{n-1} b \leq (a + b)^n$.
